test_cases.title: An exported file is deleted from its export page
acs: DERIVED: Each export page lists generated files with a Delete link - ExportContracts.aspx, ExportJobSheets.aspx, ExportRenewalLetters.aspx, ExportAddressConfirmationLetters.aspx

steps.action: Open Manage Contracts > Exports.
Click the export link of the row.
steps.expected: The export page opens with its list of files.

steps.action: Click Delete on the first file and confirm.
Wait for the page to load.
Check the page after the delete.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.
